title: Waza: Canonical SealJSON Admission & Immutable Execution Attempt DAG
summary: Release policies seal JSON documents by stripping `digest`, computing a canonical JSON-v1 SHA-256 digest (`SealJSON`), and decoding with `DisallowUnknownFields()` and strict key checks before admission. Logical execution attempts (`exec-<64 hex>`) track `distinct`, `retry`/`branch` DAG edges (1,024-record cycle limit), and digest-pinned `reuse` without re-invoking engines.
